label: Explain why actual data processing needs its applicable lawful basis, separately from technical permission
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Explain the actual distinction between system permission, assigned work and qualified applicable processing basis; trace each model case to its supplied purpose/basis/source or retain it unresolved. Do not select a basis for a real organisation, infer legal authority from an export button or treat later paperwork as retroactively establishing a missing basis.
input_specification: A qualified controller/legal instructor supplies current accessible authoritative EU GDPR/Irish-framework excerpts, the exact jurisdiction/date/service/actor applicability, complete independent explanation/case expectations and harmless synthetic records. Principles are knowledge, not permission to process real data; actual legal basis, rights/exception decisions and reporting/retention deadlines require the responsible qualified owner. No live personal data, external notification or independent legal advice is introduced. Two synthetic identical delivery databases have different purposes and owner-supplied basis/applicability evidence. One role can technically export all records but has no established basis for that additional purpose. The instructor teaches lawful-basis meaning using the exact current qualified excerpts; consent is not presented as the only possible basis or automatically valid.
output_specification: Explains actual basis/purpose/source versus technical permission; Identifies missing qualified lawfulness evidence without inventing a basis

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Explains actual basis/purpose/source versus technical permission

input_specification: A qualified food-safety/product scientist supplies a harmless exact-product training dossier, current approved validation protocol, authoritative sources and independently complete expected interpretation/result sets. label: Specify the complete qualified shelf-life validation protocol, criteria and evidence requirements before determination
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Learn to specify/check every actual required current study input, condition, sample/time/method/criterion and qualified decision/uncertainty rule before interpreting results. label: Fundraising assistant: actually acknowledge every required current donation with correct supported facts and donor preferences

definition: Explain where attention, clarification and checkback occur; identify what the correction changes and what remains unknown. label: Actually measure specimen length without unrecorded extension or fibre loss
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Perform/check the taught length method, then actually perform every complete current form-specific length method and record exact specimen, reference, setting, raw reading, unit and invalidity. Preserve breaks, lost fibres, extension or unknown tension instead of repairing the number. A reel setting or nominal supplier length alone cannot replace the verified actual prepared specimen length.
input_specification: For safe early practice the instructor provides a stable flat length reference and robust loose yarn, teaches align the start at the actual zero mark, follow the reference without unintended stretch, locate the end, read the labelled length/unit and recheck both endpoints. Qualified actual sliver, roving and yarn methods then specify every support/feed/reel/length-reference/tension/preparation setting and validity criterion; fragile strands must not be pulled into a different density. Powered or cutting actions require their separately taught current guarded equipment method and authority.
output_specification: Performs actual complete permitted length measurements for all forms; Records original specimen/reference/readings/units and method conditions; Retains extension, breakage, fibre loss and invalid length evidence

label: Actually determine specimen mass with a valid balance and retained tare basis
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Learn and actually perform every complete current mass measurement for all forms, record original gross/tare/net meanings as applicable, correct specimen/length/basis and valid stable result. Preserve under-range, drift, contamination, fibre loss or unknown readiness as invalid. Do not subtract a remembered tray value, weigh another specimen or silently round a small mass into a plausible result.
input_specification: A safe suitable qualified ready balance, appropriate sample tray and actual complete prepared specimens are supplied. The instructor teaches identify correct balance/unit/range, check the current qualified reference/readiness, place the empty permitted tray, use and verify the specified zero/tare method, add the complete exact specimen without loss/contact, wait for the actual required stable indication, read/save the raw mass/unit and recheck empty/container and identity. All additional calibration, static/draught/moisture/handling requirements and technical adjustments follow complete current qualified methods; nominal resolution is not guaranteed accuracy.
output_specification: Performs complete actual permitted mass measurements for all three forms; Preserves exact specimen/length, balance/tare/basis and original readings; Distinguishes instrument resolution, valid measurement and unresolved uncertainty

label: Compute actual direct linear density from compatible measured mass and length
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Learn the fixed-reference-length meaning, retain actual mass and nonzero compatible length units, compute/check each actual specimen direct count and interpret relative fineness only on the same basis. label: Compute actual metric inverse count and interpret its fineness direction
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Compute/check actual length per nonzero compatible mass, express Nm correctly and compare actual compatible fineness. Reconstruct the original length/mass relation to check the reciprocal and retain unrounded working before the current permitted rounding. A larger Nm means less mass per length on that common basis; no strength or quality conclusion follows from fineness alone.
input_specification: An independently authored case uses 90 m with 3 g, giving 30 m/g, written Nm 30, and about 33.33 tex on the same declared basis. Complete actual sliver/roving/yarn observations and independently checked comparisons are supplied; length per mass is not mass per length.
